snippet.title: Car Park Capital - Early Access Release Date Trailer - Voiced by Not Just Bikes
snippet.description:
🚨 Pave Paradise, and put up Car Parks soon!!

Car Park Capital launches into Early Access on October 9!

Big thank you for all the support over the years! 🙏

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3031880/Car_Park_Capital/

Car Park Capital is a satirical tycoon game, where you destroy walkable towns and turn them into parking lots, and use propaganda to convince people to pay you for it.
